Husbands provide Akaname a constant supply of fresh essence and filth, which they crave. The Akaname feeds not just on typical filth but also the invisible essence excreted from humans. They consider this aged essence especially tasty and thick. By licking their husbands, Akaname boost their essence production, providing more for the Akaname to enjoy. The Akaname's affections are intense and incessant, with their desire for sex and deep kisses to taste every part of their husbands. They aim to make their husbands dependent on such affections.}]"
